messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH severity for orcaedge-dedicated-01 — kv-sync p95 latency > 1.5s (reserved pool: orcaedge). Auto-page to #eng-oncall.

pagerduty-bot: Incident: PD-74219 - orcaedge kv-sync latency. Trigger: threshold breach for kv-sync latency on reserved cluster orcaedge-dedicated-01.

Maria A.: acked on-call (Maria A.) — looking. seeing high queue depth on orcaedge router (queue length ~1200). customers seeing 503s and slow token gen.

Devon R.: pulling metrics — p95 kv-sync latency spiked ~1500ms over last 2m, p99 ~2.4s. GC/IO on kv backends? any recent deploys to orcaedge kv-syncer?

Sasha (infra): no deploys in last 2h. KV-replica metrics show replication lag on replica-a (az-west1) — rw latency ok but replica sync stalled. Could be network flapping between nodes.

Maria A.: repro logs (short):
```
[2026-03-15T15:03:10Z] kvsyncer: sync_loop took=1623ms tenant=orcaedge shard=42 err=null
[2026-03-15T15:03:11Z] router: enqueue request tenant=orcaedge id=abc123 queue_len=1189
[2026-03-15T15:03:12Z] gateway: 503 upstream_timeout tenant=orcaedge request_id=abc123
```

Lee K.: routing shows retry jitter much higher — KV cache misses increased, so requests hit sync path. If kv-sync is slow, router backs up and we hit reserved pool soft throttle.

Maria A.: immediate mitigations proposed: 1) enable tenant fallback to shared-cache (fast path) for orcaedge; 2) scale kvsyncer workers on dedicated cluster; 3) temporarily reduce concurrency for orcaedge to drain queue.

Devon R.: I'm going to flip fallback for orcaedge to shared cache (risk: slightly different consistency guarantees but avoids customer 503s). Doing now.

ops-bot: Running action: apply route fallback for tenant orcaedge -> shared-kv-cache (run by Devon R.). Command: `infractl route update --tenant orcaedge --kv-fallback shared-kv-cache --reason "kvsync latency spike"`

ops-bot: Action succeeded. Route update applied to 6 routers.

Maria A.: monitoring impact... queue length dropping from 1189 -> 420 in 60s. 503 counts decreasing. p95 latency for request path down from 1.8s -> 480ms.

Sasha (infra): I can repro the sync stall — kafka consumer behind for replication stream on replica-a. I’m restarting the consumer on replica-a now (will be rolling restart).

Devon R.: Also lowering tenant concurrency to 10 to give headroom:
```
# change in router config
tenant.orcaedge.max_concurrency=10
```

Maria A.: concurrency change applied. queue length now ~120, slow downstream errors nearly gone. Customers reporting degraded but functional.

Lee K.: Paging update: PD-74219 acknowledged by Maria A., actioned fallback, on-call Devon R. taking lead for remediation and follow-up.

Devon R.: Rolling restart of kv replica consumer completed on replica-a. Observed replication lag catch-up, lag dropped to <50ms. Starting to scale kvsyncer workers from 3 -> 6 on orcaedge-dedicated-01.

ops-bot: Scaling command executed: `kubectl -n infra scale deployment kvsyncer-orcaedge --replicas=6` — success.

Sasha (infra): after scale and restart, kv-sync p95 now 220ms, p99 380ms. Router queues drained fully.

Maria A.: Good news — PD-74219 status changed to resolved? hold on I will mark once we stabilize for 5m. continuing to monitor 5m.

pagerduty-bot: PD-74219 updated: acknowledged -> status: under mitigation (Devon R.).

(3m later) Maria A.: Stability check at +5m: request error rate back to baseline, no new 503s from orcaedge. Holding off removing fallback for now until we validate for 30m.

Devon R.: Post-action notes: Replica consumer restart + scale fixed replication bottleneck. Root cause looks like transient Kafka partition imbalance combined with consumer thread stuck (OOM on consumer; need to confirm). I'll grab JVM heap / container logs and confirm.

Lee K.: Quick log snippet from replica-a consumer: `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` at 15:01:22. Container restarted by Kube, consumer didn't fully recover leading to lag until manual restart.

Sasha (infra): filing infra ticket INFRA-1287 to add oomguard and set JVM heap limits for kv consumers; also add alert for consumer restarts and replication lag >500ms.

Maria A.: PD-74219 -> resolved (we mark as resolved after stability window). Devon R. please own postmortem and action items with Sasha. I'll follow up with customer impact summary for orcaedge support.

Devon R.: Will do. Customer impact: orcaedge saw elevated error rates (503) for ~10m window, some slow responses for ~20m. No data loss. We'll coordinate customer outreach via CS with an incident note.

Sasha (infra): Action items (tracked INFRA-1287): [1] JVM heap limit and oomguard for kv consumers, [2] replication lag alert, [3] add circuit-breaker to prefer shared-kv fallback when replica lag > X ms, [4] run chaos test for consumer restarts.

Maria A.: thanks team. Handoff to Devon for postmortem.

Devon R.: Acknowledged. Marking thread for follow-up: I will post a short timeline + RCA in #postmortems once INFRA-1287 is created.

ops-bot: Incident PD-74219 marked resolved by Maria A. at 2026-03-15T15:12:20Z.
